name: Vybor
source:
The story follows Semyon, who finally made his choice and managed to escape the endless cycles of Sovyonok together with Lena.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=514081517]Steam[/url]]
translation:
謝苗終於作出了自己的選擇，和列娜一起逃出了小貓頭鷹營地無窮無盡的循環。這就是他的故事。

［譯自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=514081517]Steam[/url]］
